profile.headline: Software Architect and Engineering Leader | Java | Data Science | Mathematics | Machine Learning | Design, Development and Deployment
profile.summary:
Resumes are able to give hiring managers a good idea of highlighted accomplishments, but the format lacks the ability to communicate pervasive themes, no matter how relevant. Let’s endeavor to highlight the qualities I can bring to your organization.

Leadership - Going back to my time in the Movies, er, Movie Theaters, I can show a long history of successful leadership. I worked up to General Manager prior to even achieving my Associates Degree. I wanted to dive down the rabbit hole of technology, and to turn my growing ability to teach and lead into something truly fruitful and creative. These goals became justifications for restarting my education after its short but necessary hiatus. Leadership remained a prevalent theme with student government, teaching assistant positions, and even later at Atypon in my capacity as Director. 

Curiosity and Analysis - Northwestern then Atypon showed me just how much more there was to learn. University led me to explore any interest, but I was firmly grounded in mathematics and engineering, which became ML and AI. Working at Atypon cemented this, as I learned actual data management and analytics on the job. My success with SQL and Analytics led to Search, where I flourished by bringing mathematics back into my work. Recommendations, related works, vectorization, automated topic modeling, and browse-experience optimization via classification became the projects that thrust me back into leadership.

Perceptiveness and Creativity - My first true software engineering problem came during my tenure at Century Theaters: addressing the loss of certain needed software functionality. In 2006 Cinemark purchased Century Theaters and brought with it a fully revamped human resources and scheduling module. A GM wouldn’t be expected to build a solution to this problem, but a concurrently enrolled student at Foothill College who eventually succeeded in a transfer to a Big-10 University certainly would. I saw requirements, emulated a successful design, and built in new features I always wanted to have access to. 

At Atypon my work with search alerted me to problems with our discovery platform - many disparate implementations with similar aims - customers wanted to partition and browse through content. I turned our clients’ clear desires into a fully customizable platform, and as a side effect made our implemented solutions significantly more maintainable.

Looking for an exciting opportunity to build things, whether as an individual contributor or as a leader of a team. Open to challenges not limited to past experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Founding member of Alexa Shopping MIDAS Deals Discovery and Engagement. Owner of Deals, Discounts, and Promotions management service across Alexa Shopping platform. Pioneering Agentic AI to bridge Gen AI interactivity into rich customer-focused Shopping Experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Software Design · Programming · Algorithms · Spring Framework · Elasticsearch · Artificial Intelligence · Lucene · Data Analysis · Databases · Performance Tuning · Optimization · JSON · Node.js · AspectJ · Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) · Testing · JUnit · TestNG · RESTful WebServices · Logging · Debugging · Jira

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Classification, Inference, and Learning
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Served Principal Architect, Engineer, and Owner of a configurable metadata persistence service and inference engine. Focus on various applications such as topical hierarchies (taxonomies), authorship and funding, data extraction, text-based automated classification, and more than anything customization. Anything a customer could want or need when it came to searchable metadata. Led a team ranging in size from 4-7 junior to senior engineers from hiring to long term professional development. Honored with Director of Engineering title during this period, though minimal additional responsibilities made this functionally identical to a Senior Software Engineering role.

positions.title: Software Engineer- Information Discovery
positions.description:
Hired as 1 of 2 primary engineers to develop and maintain the reporting and database components of Atypon’s Literatum. Quickly promoted to point of contact for Search within Information Discovery (September 2011). Grew into search team lead as size of group increased from 2 up to 7 at the time of promotion to ownership of personal component.

Notable Achievements:

•  Completely rewrote an expansive, out of control collection of more than 3-dozen customized search procedures into a unified component. This started out as an entirely self-motivated project and has now become the basis for the penned “Search 2.0” redesign effort over the next year.
•  Created an extremely fast and powerful faceted content browsing system which led to leaps in customizable front ends for clients. The system enabled ‘search driven widgets’ which expanded to encompass the gross majority of the deliverable front end tools with the launch of the highly user configurable Pagebuilder system.
•  Designed systems with improved scalability, resulting in speed improvements measurable in orders of magnitude for the largest publishers.

positions.title: Summer Research Intern / Visiting Scientist
positions.description:
Joined an experienced research group to develop solutions for the demands of a modern military, a multi-year project called Deep Green.  Results and methods were further researched and integrated into the developing code base.

Notable Achievements:

•  Built a system for tracking the relationship of observations to course grained simulations of military encounters based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo derived Particle Filters. Invented Durative Transition Instantaneous State Model for Tracking in Deep Green with Bob Price, as well as grounding the model in probabilistic theory. 
•  Invented a method for disambiguating various types of multi-unit interactions along the course of creating coarse grained simulations, based on leveraging graphics algorithms and 3D computational geometry to both prevent combinatorial explosions and draw intelligent inferences.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Part of a 3 programmer development team working on nuWar, a plugin for an existing sketch based system that turned US Army battle plans into a turn based strategy game, Advised by Ken Forbus and Johan de Kleer
• Personal duties included redesigning the simulation to conform with modern military models of hostile attrition, integrating a continuous time model for deterministic encounter resolution, leveraging this model for stronger inferences, and cleaning up system API and resource usage

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description: • Taught single variable and vector calculus, holding weekly review lectures, examination sessions, and office hours.

positions.title: General Manager / Special Projects in IT
positions.description:
•	Created and maintained comprehensive payroll management and Human Resource compliance tools in use across the company
•	Sole point person for hiring, firing, budget, human resource compliance, sales and presentation for a 65 person organization
